notes.title: Major Update: BOT.VINNIK Gets a Sharper Tongue (and a Softer Side)
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, comrades![/p][p]
While we’re hard at work on the next entry in the series — [b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy[/b] — we’ve brought a slice of that new personality over to [b]Prodigies[/b]. This update adds a [b]big batch of brand-new BOT.VINNIK reactions[/b] (both praise and sarcasm) pulled straight from the upcoming game, giving your training sessions more variety, timing polish, and fewer repeated lines.[/p][p][b]What’s in this update[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Dozens of new reaction lines[/b] for correct and incorrect moves[/p][/*][*][p][b]Snappier delivery[/b] and [b]less repetition[/b] during sessions[/p][/*][*][p]Minor text polish[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]If you enjoy this upgraded personality, consider [b]wishlisting[/b] the new game here:
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing and for all your feedback![/p]

notes.title: BOT.VINNIK is back—Playtest Chess Masters Academy now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello comrades![/p][p][/p][p]BOT.VINNIK is back in a bigger, better, and more ambitious form: [b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy![/b] We've learned so much from our earlier games—thanks largely to your valuable feedback—and now we need your help once again![/p][p]The playtest is live and available directly through the Steam Playtest feature on the game's Steam page. No signup, no hassle—just request access and start playing.[/p][p]Your feedback is essential to make BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy the chess platform you've always wanted. Let's shape it together![/p][p][/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/"]Access Playtest on Steam[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support, and see you at the academy![/p][p]— Rodrigo & Eduardo
Deep Green Games[/p]

notes.title: The BOT.VINNIK you’ve been waiting for is finally here!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello, comrades![/b][/p][p][/p][p]You may have noticed we’ve been radio silent for a while—but there’s a good reason: we’ve spent the last few years working on the most ambitious BOT.VINNIK project to date![/p][p][/p][p]🎉 [b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy[/b] is now live on Steam:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This new game is the culmination of everything we’ve learned from the previous titles in the series. Alongside a brand-new visual style, it features:[/p][list][*][p]A reworked scoring system[/p][/*][*][p]Structured progression across lessons[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple difficulty levels[/p][/*][*][p]A growing platform powered by future DLCs[/p][/*][*][p]And even a beginner mode for those who don’t know how the knight moves yet[/p][/*][/list][p]Of course, BOT.VINNIK’s trademark sarcasm and brutal honesty are back and sharper than ever.[/p][p]A free demo will be released soon — until then, check out the trailer and hit that Wishlist button to let BOT.VINNIK know you’re still worthy of being called "comrade."
(YouTube™ embed: “BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy – Reveal Trailer”)[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support over the years!
[/p][p]See you at the Academy.
—Rodrigo & Eduardo
Deep Green Games[/p]
